concrete_wall.notes: Damp dark cast concrete: formwork seam + tie holes with rust streaks, cracks with efflorescence, vertical water streaks, pores. One panel seam per repeat.

concrete_floor.notes: Dark scuffed floor slab: saw-cut joint, exposed aggregate wear, oil stains (glossy), cracks, scuffs, grime.

metal_grate.notes: Bar floor grating, 16 serrated bearing bars x 8 cross bars per repeat; holes are alpha cutout (alpha test 0.5). Rust + mud in the joints.

metal_diamond.notes: Worn steel diamond tread plate: polished bump tops, grime and rust in the valleys, scuffs.

metal_rusted.notes: Heavily rusted steel: flaking scale, pitting, rust bloom, run streaks, remnants of old grey paint and exposed steel.

metal_painted.notes: Neutral light-grey worn industrial paint (tint the albedo in the material: green/grey/yellow/red). Chips reveal primer, steel and rust; rust bleed streaks.

metal_bare.notes: Brushed / scratched bare steel for tool heads and rails; fingerprints, tarnish and small rust spots.

hazard_stripes.notes: Worn black/yellow 45 degree caution stripes (4 pairs per repeat along U), paint wear to steel, scuffs, grime.

rubber.notes: Dark worn rubber (cables, grips, hoses): ozone micro-cracks, abrasion, dust in pores.

plastic.notes: Neutral light moulded plastic (tinted in Unity: yellow/orange/black/gray); fine texture, scuffs, scratches, grime.

rock_dry.notes: Dry grey-brown fractured rock (cliffs, boulders, terrain B channel): facets, cracks, dust on ledges, sparse lichen. Works triplanar.

rock_wet.notes: Dark wet rock: glossy water film in cavities and run streaks, drier matte ridges, algae tint. Works triplanar.

rock_mine.notes: Dark brownish blasted mine rock: half-barrel drill holes, pick/chisel gouges, faceted fractures, dust on upward faces. Works triplanar.

ore_iron.notes: Iron ore: dark rock with metallic hematite/magnetite veins and flecks (metallic in mask R), red-brown oxide halos.

ore_copper.notes: Copper ore: grey-brown rock with metallic red-orange native copper veins, green malachite / verdigris patina crusts around them (matte).

crystal.notes: Pale cyan luminous crystal facets; internal fractures and cloudy inclusions; _E emission glows strongest along fractures and facet cores.

blackstone.notes: Near-black light-absorbing glassy stone (obsidian-like): conchoidal ripple fractures, faint violet sheen (slight metallic/violet spec on glassy faces), matte weathered patches.

anomalous.notes: Fleshy red/black organic-metal: dark plated metal with bulging vein network; _E emission glows red-orange in the veins and nodes.

mineral_crust.notes: Crusted mineral growths over stone: botryoidal nodules, pale chalky crust with ochre/rust staining, small crystalline glints (smoothness).

wood_planks.notes: Weathered grey-brown floor/wall planks (6 boards per repeat along V, grain along U), staggered butt joints, knots, nail holes, dirt in the gaps.

wood_crate.notes: Rough-sawn pine crate boards (4 per repeat along V), saw marks, nail heads, grime; lighter than planks.

wood_rotten.notes: Dark wet decaying wood: deep splits along U, punky eroded areas, fungal staining and mould, glossy wet patches.

wood_beam.notes: Heavy dark mine timber (grain along U): long drying checks, adze scallops, oily grime and dust.

wood_handle.notes: Hand-worn hardwood tool handle (ash/hickory, grain along U): fine straight grain, polished grip wear with grime, varnish remnants.

bark_pine.notes: Pine bark, tiles vertically along V (and U): deep furrows between flaky layered plates, reddish exposed scales, grey weathered tops, lichen specks.

bark_dead.notes: Pale grey weathered dead wood, twisted grain (tiles along V), long splits, a few remaining dark bark patches.

forest_floor.notes: Dark forest soil densely littered with dead leaves, pine needles and twigs; terrain base layer.

mud.notes: Wet dark mud with smeared ruts, grit, small stones and glossy puddles (puddles flat + smoothness ~0.93). Terrain R channel.

moss.notes: Dense damp moss cushions: granular shoots, yellow-green tops, dark gaps, brown dead patches. Terrain G channel.

skin_decayed.notes: Stretched pale grey-brown decayed skin: mottling, bruising, dark veins, wrinkles/stretch marks, crusted lesions with wet glossy cores.

mourner_skin.notes: Tight grey-brown wrinkled hairless skin (Mourner): multi-scale crease network, pale scar lines, slight waxy sheen.

meat.notes: Raw red meat: muscle fibre striations, white-pink fat marbling, silver-skin, wet glossy surface.

flesh.notes: Wet torn dark-red flesh: shredded fibrous strands, dark clots, pale tissue, glossy membranes (MNF_Flesh, wounds, gore).

fabric_canvas.notes: Dirty olive-khaki cotton canvas, plain weave (~96 threads per repeat), slubs, water-stain tide marks, grime.

fabric_blanket.notes: Coarse worn wool blanket: 2/2 twill, fuzzy fibres, faded dark stripes, pilling and stains; dull grey-brown.

rope.notes: Dirty twisted hemp rope: 3 strands around V, twisting along U (map U along the rope length, V around it), fibres and fuzz.

paper.notes: Aged yellowed paper: fibres, foxing spots, coffee-ring and water tide stains, faint fold creases (notes, posters, labels).

water.notes: Only _N: gentle tileable ripple normal for puddles/flooded floors (scroll two copies in opposite directions).

fur_rotten.notes: Matted dirty brown-grey fur with converging clumps, grime and wet strands, bald patches of sick skin (Rotten creatures).

fur_rabbit.notes: Soft dense agouti rabbit fur (grey-brown, dark band, pale tips), gentle flow.

fur_rabbit_mangy.notes: Rabbit fur with irregular mange: bald patches of dark stretched wrinkled skin, scabs, thinning broken fur at the patch edges.

fur_boar.notes: Dark coarse bristly boar hide: long thick straight bristles with grizzled grey tips over dark skin.

fur_dark.notes: Dusty near-black grimy fur: dark matted strands, dust-greyed tips and grime clumps.

foliage_pine.notes: Alpha-cutout card (not tiling): dense dark conifer branch, stem enters at bottom centre and grows up. Two-sided, alpha test ~0.4.

foliage_leaf.notes: Alpha-cutout card: twig with a cluster of dead/dark withered leaves (olive, brown, near-black), holes and curled tips.

fern.notes: Alpha-cutout card: arching fern fronds radiating from the bottom centre, dark green with browning tips.

grass.notes: Alpha-cutout card: wild grass tuft rooted along the bottom edge, muted green with dry yellowed blades.

fx_dust.notes: Particle: soft dust mote (pale grey, alpha falloff).

fx_spark.notes: Particle: hot spark streak (white-yellow core, orange glow); use additive, stretched billboard.

fx_smoke.notes: Particle: soft billowy grey smoke puff.

fx_fog.notes: Particle: very soft large fog cloud, low alpha (max ~0.5).

fx_glow.notes: Particle/flare: smooth radial falloff glow, white (tint in material).

fx_drip.notes: Particle: falling water drip (translucent teardrop with highlight).

fx_debris.notes: Particle: small rock/concrete chips cluster (sheet of irregular fragments).

screen_scanlines.notes: Tileable CRT overlay (alpha-blended): soft dark scanlines every 4 px, faint aperture grille, sparse static noise and a slow roll band.

signs_atlas.notes: 4x4 sign atlas (256px cells, index=row*4+col, row 0 top): 0 DANGER/AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY, 1 KEEP GATE CLOSED, 2 SURVIVOR BUNKER 7, 3 MINE ACCESS ->, 4 HIGH VOLTAGE, 5 LEVEL 1, 6 LEVEL 2, 7 LEVEL 3 - NO ENTRY, 8 EVACUATION ROUTE <-, 9 ASSAY / TRADE, 10 EQUIPMENT, 11 STORAGE, 12 MISSING poster, 13 DO NOT FOLLOW THE LIGHT (scrawl), 14 marker 03, 15 trail sign MINE 400m ^. Opaque.

decals_atlas.notes: 4x4 alpha-blended decal atlas (256px cells, row 0 top): 0 crack, 1 water stain streaks, 2 grime patch, 3 oil stain, 4 claw scratches x3, 5 deep claw scratches x4, 6 dirty monkey hand print, 7 long-fingered creature footprint, 8 dark dried stain splatter, 9 scrawled tally marks, 10 scorch mark, 11 moss patch, 12 rust drip streaks, 13 painted orange arrow, 14 painted X, 15 drag marks. Alpha fades to 0 before every cell border.
